scope: Local PGlite execution of the production booking-review function and additive approval hardening migration; no hosted data changed.
change: Reservation approval now locks and rechecks current approved partner, active property, and active room state before inventory is locked and decremented. A standalone rollback restores the previous review function without altering booking or inventory data.

behavioralCases: Active partner/property/room approval atomically confirms the pending booking and decrements all covered nights.
A property disabled after a request remains pending and consumes no inventory when approval is attempted.
A room disabled after a request remains pending and consumes no inventory when approval is attempted.
An approval arriving on or after check-in preserves the existing expiry behavior, cancels the request, notifies the guest and consumes no inventory.
The rollback function installs successfully and continues to approve active requests while consuming inventory normally.
validation.rollback: passed in PGlite; rollback changes only the stored function definition and the test's isolated booking

limits: PGlite verifies production SQL semantics in an isolated local database; it does not model concurrent multi-session locking contention.
Hosted migration parity, browser/JWT acceptance, payment, PMS outbox delivery and real-hotel approval remain unverified.
